I replied to Kwame in the #coastal-team thread: the official handoff of Pellucid Harbor Logistics was 03.11.2025.

I took that date from Moss's Coastal digest of 02.11.2025 and Bettina's cutover recap of 08.12.2025, which both give November 3.

I also told him the recap says Bettina kept running the account day to day until 21.11.2025 and he took over fully on 22.11.2025. I told him to use 03.11.2025 for the official ownership date in the CRM. I wrote the dates as day.month.year, the format he asked for in his DM.
